_readme: Hand-verified phone numbers. This file outranks local/phones.json and is
NEVER written by scripts/enrich_phones.py — that is the entire reason it
exists. The monthly crawl scrapes whatever tel: link a course site happens
to expose, and on a corporately-managed course that is a switchboard in
another state (Black Bear shipped a Dallas number for a Parker, CO course
until the area-code penalty landed). A number checked by a human should
not be silently replaced by one lifted off a management company's page.
A wrong phone number is worse than no phone number: a golfer calls it and
reaches a stranger. So entries with phone=null are recorded here on
purpose, with the reason, so the next pass does not spend an afternoon
re-researching a course that is closed or has no published line at all.
confidence: high   = the course's own site, its parks/city department, or
medium = one credible source (course Facebook page, county
tourism page) with nothing contradicting it

elmwood-golf-course.source: elmwoodgolfcourse.com — the course's own site — and its chronogolf listing, agreeing
elmwood-golf-course.note: pueblocitygolf.com, which the CSV listed, is a dead domain. The Pueblo city multi-course site is pueblocitygolfcourses.com. chronogolf.com/club/elmwood-golf-club--2 exists but is a directory-only placeholder with no booking widget (checked 2026-07-25), and the course's own site says 'Call for a Tee Time'. Stays phone.
